maria: VerdantCare POC - need perf run + pricing + KMS sign-off. Customer asks sustained 500 qps, bursts to 1500 for ~5m, p95 <150ms at up to 512 tokens. Wed 10-11am PT?
ajay: Need model variant (we recommend redwood-chat-recommend), avg seq ~280 tokens, quantized ok if tail penalty <15%.
tara: Proposed plan: smoke 50 -> ramp to 500 over 8m -> hold 30m -> 3 bursts to 1500 (5m each) with 15m cooldowns. Canary to Dedicated, fallback to smaller hosted model if SLOs break.
ajay: HW: Dedicated A100 suggested; q8 quant hits median but fp16 safer for tails. BYOK adds ~2-3% first-call latency; KV cache will mitigate.
kevin: Customer needs burst pricing delta to budget.
ajay: Ballpark: bursts add ~35-45% incremental token cost during burst windows depending on cache hit rate and batching. Will post calc post-smoke.
riley: KMS checklist: provide key ARN + policy granting our service principal; confirm regional key placement; if egress restricted, need allowlist. Multi-AZ asked by customer adds ~10-20ms median. Recommend running single-AZ and multi-AZ modes in POC and compare.
loadbot: perf job queued: verdantcare-wed-10am (id: ft-499999). Results will be posted here.
maria: Tara please get KMS contact/ARN; Kevin confirm budget threshold. If all good I'll schedule and attach pre-run checklist. Thanks.
